title: SEC delays in-kind redemption decision for Bitwise crypto ETFs
description: The US SEC has extended its decision deadline on whether to allow in-kind redemptions for Bitwise’s spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs on NYSE Arca.

title: 14-Year-Old BTC Wallet Moves Another $4.77B — Selling Pressure Ahead?
description: TL;DR A legendary Bitcoin wallet, untouched since 2011, has just moved another 40,192 BTC, worth about $4. 77 billion, fueling new speculation about more large-scale sales.
